summary: Shape a clear property-agent brand with positioning, listing messages, content planning, and enquiry tracking. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Personal branding for real estate agents defines how property sales and leasing professionals present their value consistently to clients. This foundation course is for agents, leasing professionals, and brokerage team leads who need a practical brand plan, covering client segmentation and positioning, AIDA-based listing messages, and content planning with review and enquiry tracking.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for property professionals who represent themselves or a brokerage in client-facing conversations, listings, and digital channels.
prerequisites: No formal marketing qualification is specified. Familiarity with property listings, client enquiries, or real estate service work will help you apply the exercises.
